hints.text: Precomputing total counts of even and odd values enables constant time answer derivation.

hints.title: Algorithmic Strategy and State
hints.text: Iterate left to right while decrementing the current element's parity count.

hints.title: Optimal Boundary and Processing
hints.text: The score for the current index equals the remaining count of the alternate parity.

hints.title: Complete Implementation
hints.text:
```python
def countOppositeParity(nums: list[int]) -> list[int]:
    cnt = [0, 0]
    for x in nums:
        cnt[x % 2] += 1
    ans = []
    for x in nums:
        p = x % 2
        cnt[p] -= 1
        ans.append(cnt[1 - p])
    return ans
```
